correctionReason: Independent pre-score review found same-Work recording aliases. The first run produced partial vectors and stopped with exit130 before any fold or metric. Relevance labels remain unchanged and were preregistered before that run. This manifest corrects identity before renewed inference.
scope: All 24 cohort Works audited across 1160 frozen raw cards whose declared creators contain the cohort surnames; known recordings, translations and abridged editions share identity. Distinct sequels, retellings, poems and anthologies remain separate. This is a conservative frozen-corpus identity assertion, not a universal bibliography.
representativeRule: Lexicographically first source identifier among recordings matching the original preregistered English title/titleAliases after generic normalization, excluding the author suffix now repaired. No selection depends on embeddings or scores. The actual source title, creator, subject and description are used for both backends.
